summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] to ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the title sequence (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) to CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT and Control.title(title); rich/_windows_renderer.py calls term.set_title(title) for SET_WINDOW_TITLE; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated on is_terminal. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not run, per instructions; nothing committed. Interpretation: "show_cursor passes" was read as the is_terminal gate that show_cursor uses. The console test is skipped on win32 as a whole.
